A '''Jedi shuttle''' was operated during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="The Jedi and the Thief" /> Around [[233 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{YJADate|117A}}</ref> [[Jedi Master]] [[Zia Zaldor Zanna]] piloted one during her trip to the [[planet]] [[Rex Strata]] with [[Jedi Initiate]] [[Kai Brightstar]].<ref name="The Jedi and the Thief" />
